paragraphs: Rav Yosef son of Rav Shmuel.

He is mentioned in [Zevachim 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.6b.13), where he posed a difficulty to Rav Papa. But the reading in the Shitah Mekubetzet is “son of Rav Shemaya,” which Hyman considers correct.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Yosef son of Rav Shmuel posing the question to Rav Papa. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2032&lang=en) cites the same passage. Hyman prefers son of Rav Shemaya, which he reports from Shitah Mekubetzet.

Shitah Mekubetzet remains the supplied work title without author/edition identification. Son of Rav Shemaya differs from son of Rav Shmuel; והוא הנכון is Hyman’s firm judgment, not fresh verification.

The headed Yosef is naturally the implicit person posing a difficulty to Papa. All four full רב titles are retained; the absence of an explicit repeated subject does not reverse questioner and addressee.
